GitRepository.name: destroy

GitRepository.description: Resolve with an initialized status snapshot, loading it on first call. Concurrent callers share one in-flight refresh.

GitRepository.name: getAheadBehindCount
GitRepository.description: The ahead and behind commit counts.

GitRepository.name: getBlame
GitRepository.description: Read line-by-line blame for a file.

GitRepository.name: getBlob
GitRepository.description: Read a blob's contents by object id (git cat-file -p <oid>).

GitRepository.name: getBranchesContaining
GitRepository.description: The fully-qualified refnames of branches that contain a commit (git branch --contains).

GitRepository.name: getCachedUpstreamAheadBehindCount
GitRepository.description: Get the cached ahead/behind commit counts for the current branch's upstream branch.

GitRepository.name: getCommit

GitRepository.name: getCommits
GitRepository.description: Read paginated commit history.

GitRepository.name: getDescription
GitRepository.description: Describe HEAD as a ref name (git describe --contains --all --always). Returns a Promise resolving to the String description, or "" when the branch is unborn.

GitRepository.name: getDiff
GitRepository.description: Compute a structured diff between two endpoints.

GitRepository.name: getDirectoryStatusSummary
GitRepository.description: Aggregate classified status for a directory, including the repository root. Same sourcing and shape as .getPathStatusSummary (without renamed); returns null when nothing below the directory has a reportable status.

GitRepository.name: getFileAtRevision
GitRepository.description: Read a file's contents at a revision.

GitRepository.name: getFileMode
GitRepository.description: The index mode of a path (git ls-files --stage).

GitRepository.description: Computes gutter line diffs off the renderer thread via the git-host worker (fetching and caching the HEAD blob, diffing in JS) instead of synchronously via libgit2.

GitRepository.name: getOperations
GitRepository.description: stable write facade assigned by lumine.repositories. Its methods are enabled by repositories.operations-provider services.

GitRepository.name: getOriginURL
GitRepository.description: origin url of the repository, read from the refs snapshot's remotes. Returns null until the snapshot has loaded or when the repository has no origin remote.

GitRepository.name: getPath
GitRepository.description: path of the repository.

GitRepository.name: getPathStatusSummary
GitRepository.description: Classified status for one path, read from the detailed status snapshot.

GitRepository.name: getReferences
GitRepository.description: Gets all the local and remote references.

GitRepository.name: getReferenceTarget
GitRepository.description: The current SHA for the reference, or null when it is unavailable.

GitRepository.name: getRefsSnapshot
GitRepository.description: latest immutable refs snapshot. It contains head, local branches with upstream tracking, remoteBranches, tags, remotes with fetch and push URLs, worktrees, and a monotonic generation. Branch and tag entries include lastCommit metadata for their target commit. The initial snapshot has initialized: false; subscribe with .onDidChangeRefsSnapshot or call .ensureRefsSnapshot to load it.

GitRepository.name: getShortHead
GitRepository.description: Retrieves a shortened version of the HEAD reference value.

GitRepository.name: getStatusEntry
GitRepository.description: detailed cached status for a repository path, or null.

GitRepository.name: getStatusSnapshot
GitRepository.description: latest immutable detailed status snapshot. It contains head, upstream, per-file staged/unstaged/conflict state, aggregate counts, and a monotonic generation. The initial snapshot has initialized: false; subscribe with .onDidChangeStatusSnapshot or call .ensureStatusSnapshot to load it.

GitRepository.name: getSubmodulePaths
GitRepository.description: The repository-relative paths of the repository's submodules (git submodule status).

GitRepository.name: getType
GitRepository.description: A String indicating the type of version control system used by this repository.

GitRepository.name: getUpstreamBranch
GitRepository.description: The upstream branch, such as refs/remotes/origin/master, or null when HEAD has no upstream.

GitRepository.name: getWorkingDirectory
GitRepository.description: working directory path of the repository.

GitRepository.name: hasBranch
GitRepository.description: true if the given branch exists.

GitRepository.name: isDestroyed
GitRepository.description: indicating if this repository has been destroyed.

GitRepository.name: isPathIgnored
GitRepository.description: Is the given path ignored? Resolved from the detailed status snapshot's ignored entries; returns false until the snapshot has loaded.

GitRepository.name: isPathIgnoredCached
GitRepository.description: Whether the given path is ignored, resolved synchronously from the Git status snapshot's ignored entries. Returns false until the first snapshot loads.

GitRepository.name: isPathModified
GitRepository.description: Whether the path is modified in the detailed status snapshot. Returns false until the snapshot loads.

GitRepository.name: isPathNew
GitRepository.description: Whether the path is new in the detailed status snapshot. Returns false until the snapshot loads.

GitRepository.name: isPresent
GitRepository.description: whether this repository's Git directory still exists.

GitRepository.name: isProjectAtRoot
GitRepository.description: true if at the root, false if in a subfolder of the repository.

GitRepository.name: isSubmodule
GitRepository.description: Is the given path a submodule in the repository?

GitRepository.name: onDidChangeRefsSnapshot
GitRepository.description: Invoke the given callback when the repository refs snapshot changes. Subscribing declares interest exactly like .onDidChangeStatusSnapshot: the first subscriber triggers a lazy load and refs stay fresh with debounced background refreshes.

GitRepository.name: onDidChangeStatus
GitRepository.description: Invoke the given callback when a specific file's status has changed. When a file is updated, reloaded, etc, and the status changes, this will be fired.

GitRepository.name: onDidChangeStatuses
GitRepository.description: Invoke the given callback when multiple files' statuses have changed. Prefer .onDidChangeStatusSnapshot; this legacy event is retained for API compatibility.

GitRepository.name: onDidChangeStatusSnapshot
GitRepository.description: Invoke the given callback when the detailed repository status snapshot changes.

GitRepository.name: onDidDestroy
GitRepository.description: Invoke the given callback when this GitRepository's destroy() method is invoked.

GitRepository.name: refreshRefsSnapshot

GitRepository.name: refreshStatusSnapshot
GitRepository.description: Refresh the detailed branch and file status snapshot with Git. Concurrent calls coalesce into at most one in-flight and one trailing subprocess; see coalesceSnapshotRefresh.

GitRepository.name: relativize
GitRepository.description: Makes a path relative to the repository's working directory.
